# ue-render-profiles-toolset

> Versioned Unreal Engine render profiles (CVars and scalability): a pure core with profile resolution, catalog validation, diff, apply and revert plans, and a thin Unreal adapter. Python package `trysac-ue-render-profiles-toolset`, import name `ue_render_profiles_toolset`, MIT licensed, Python >= 3.11, no runtime dependencies. Ships as the Python-only Unreal MCP plugin `RenderProfilesToolset` (toolset `RenderProfileTools`). Tested in CI against fakes; not yet verified inside Unreal.
